lounges.name: Bidvest Premier Lounge · International 2
lounges.location: Mezzanine near the B-gate escalator; turn left after passport control and continue past Gate A3.

hours.note: The operator publishes 05:00 opening, while Priority Pass lists 04:00. Use 05:00 conservatively; confirm earlier access directly. Hours can vary with flights.

lounges.note: Separate from Premier 1 and the domestic lounge. The operator lists light meals/snacks and à-la-carte options; dining style and any meal charges are unverified here. Entry earlier than four hours before departure can cost extra; no online or group bookings are accepted at this location.

qualityRating.summary: An August 2026 review found this B-gate lounge more spacious than Premier 1, with comfortable seating and a solid hot/cold food spread. Power outlets were unevenly distributed; the meal selection was useful rather than exceptional.

sources.title: Points to Seats · Bidvest International 2, August 2026

recommendation.summary: A shower option before an international flight, within the published four-hour entry window.
